vulnerabilities.justification: Our project runs on Python 3.9, which does not expose the vulnerable TLSStream IDNA 2003 path. The CVE is not exploitable in our environment.
We do not accept untrusted file uploads. Arbitrary file write via path traversal is not exploitable in our deployment.
Multipart headers are bounded by FastAPI’s request size limits. DoS via excessive headers is not exploitable.
